_readme: Hand-maintained for now, unlike dashboard_data.json (which pjm_pipeline.py regenerates from a live queue export). Virginia's figures come from Dominion's own SCC testimony (no automated tracker yet -- dominion_scc_tracker.py doesn't exist, see CLAUDE.md). Texas's figures are pulled from ercot_large_load_history.json, written by ercot_large_load_tracker.py -- update this file's TX block by hand whenever that history file gets a new record, until a small script does it automatically. Every stat here is a snapshot from a specific filing/report date, not live data -- render it with the as_of date visible, never as if it updates continuously.
